senses.en_definition: A financial institution that accepts deposits, provides loans, exchanges currencies, and offers other financial services.
A store or reserve of something kept for future use, or a facility where it is held.

messages.en: I'm going to the bank first. What time will you get to the restaurant?
Around one. If you need more time at the bank, just let me know. I can wait.
Okay, I'll text you when I'm out of the bank.

senses.en_definition: To help, assist, or support someone.

messages.en: Are you home? Could you help me lift this box? It's really heavy.
Yes, I'm home. Hang on, I'm coming down now. Let's lift it together.

senses.en_definition: Help or support provided through supplies, money, or action.

messages.en: If you need a hand moving stuff this evening, let me know. I've finished work.
That would be great! This wardrobe's heavy. I can't lift it on my own. Can you come over at six?

senses.en_definition: Large in number or quantity; many or much.
In large amounts or to a great degree; a lot.
The amount or number of something, especially in questions about quantity.

messages.en: What time are you heading home today? Still got a lot of work to do?
Yeah, loads. You go ahead. I want to finish this report first.
